title: Association between the retinal age gap and systemic diseases in the Japanese population: the Nagahama study
summary: retinal age model fine-tuned in 2,261 healthy participants (validation MAE 3.28 years), then applied to 6,070 Nagahama participants. Cross-sectional age-gap associations included diabetes and hyperlipidemia; longitudinal disease onset was null, with only marginal temporal associations. Association is non-causal. The admission is restricted to this measured result and study setting; it is not evidence of deployment benefit.
organization: Department of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences, Kyoto University Graduate School of Medicine, Kyoto, Japan
